people.name: Mark S. G. Dyczkowski
people.bio: English Indologist and sitarist who lived four decades in Varanasi; Lakshmanjoo initiate (1976), Oxford DPhil under Alexis Sanderson; translated the Spanda texts, the Manthānabhairava Tantra and all 37 chapters of the Tantrāloka with Jayaratha’s commentary (11 vols, completed 2024).
people.correction: deep-tantra people.json lists him as "b. 1951" (alive); he died 2 Feb 2025 (Indology list post by Brian Campbell; Journal of Dharma Studies obituary).

people.name: Arjun Seernels
people.bio: Close student of Mark Dyczkowski who co-leads the Anuttara Trika Kula online Reading Circles on the Tantrāloka (from April 2026).

people.name: Brian Campbell
people.bio: Student of Mark Dyczkowski and Sanskritist who co-leads the Anuttara Trika Kula Reading Circles; announced Dyczkowski’s death and the completed Tantrāloka translation on the INDOLOGY list.

people.name: Bettina Sharada Bäumer
people.bio: Austrian-born Indian Indologist in Varanasi since 1967, disciple of Swami Lakshmanjoo, Padma Shri 2015; directs Samvidalaya (Abhinavagupta Research Library) and gives five-day text-and-meditation retreat seminars; autobiography The Light In-Between (2025).

people.name: Acharya Rameshwar Jha
people.bio: Varanasi pandit and Kashmir Śaiva teacher under whom the young Mark Dyczkowski studied.

people.name: Pandit Hemendra (Hemant) Nath Chakravarti
people.bio: Varanasi scholar, disciple of Gopinath Kaviraj, editor of a Tantrasāra translation; teacher of Mark Dyczkowski from 1971.

people.name: Gopinath Kaviraj
people.bio: Varanasi Sanskrit scholar and Tantric adept, disciple of Vishuddhananda and close to Anandamayi Ma.

people.name: Gurumayi Chidvilasananda
people.bio: Head of Siddha Yoga who inaugurated the Muktabodha Indological Research Institute in 1997.

people.name: Guru Yogi Matsyendranath Maharaj (Matsyeshvarnath)
people.bio: Russian-born Nāth yogi who lived long among Nāths in India, received full initiation and guru status, and teaches Nāth haṭha and tantric sādhanā internationally through nathas.org.

people.name: Yogi Lakshminath Maharaj
people.bio: Teacher in the nathas.org community who leads online courses on prāṇāyāma, meditation, āsana and Śiva Sūtra satsangs.

people.name: Yogi Allamanath
people.bio: Teacher in the nathas.org community (tea satsangs and talks on the NathaChannel).

people.name: Guru Yogi Mithileshnath Maharaj
people.bio: Dharmanāth-panthī sadhu of Gorakhpur, student of Yogi Kamalnath and Yogi Dasharathnath, appointed head of the Nāth temple at Devi Patan in 2011; guru of Yogi Matsyendranath.

people.name: Yogi Kamalnath
people.bio: Main pujari of the Gorakhnath Mandir, Gorakhpur; teacher of Yogi Mithileshnath.

people.name: Yogi Adityanath
people.bio: Mahant (Peethadhishwar) of the Gorakhnath Math and president of the Nāth order’s Yogi Mahasabha; also a politician (Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh). Recorded here only in his religious office.

people.name: Yogi Nirmalnath
people.bio: Rajasthan-born Nāth yogi anointed Raja (head) of the Kadri Jogi Mutt, Mangaluru, on 7 March 2016 for the 12-year term.

people.name: Swami (Sannyasi) Charanashrit Giri
people.bio: Founder-guru of Swara Yoga Peeth, Rishikesh; karma-sannyāsin of Paramahamsa Niranjanananda (Bihar School of Yoga), teaching the Śiva Svarodaya since 1993; titled Mahamandaleshwar in recent videos.

people.name: Swami Sadatmananda Saraswati
people.bio: Chief ācārya of Arsha Vidya Gurukulam, Anaikatti, since 2014 and paramount trustee of Sruti Seva Trust; trained under Swami Brahmatmananda (Baroda, 1986) and taught at Arsha Vidya Kendra Bangalore 1994–2014.

people.name: Swami Brahmatmananda
people.bio: Student of Swami Dayananda who ran a three-year Vedānta course in Baroda (1986) attended by Swami Sadatmananda.

people.name: Swami Shankarananda Saraswati (Arsha Vidya)
people.bio: Disciple of Swami Dayananda teaching online Vedānta classes and retreats for AVG Anaikatti; ācārya of its Jan–Mar 2027 residential course. Distinct from Swami Shankarananda of Shiva Ashram (Kashmir Shaivism).

people.name: Swami Sakshatkrtananda Saraswati
people.bio: Senior Arsha Vidya teacher associated with Swami Dayananda Ashram, Rishikesh (listed in its About menu; ashram contact address sakshat1949@).

people.name: Mahamahopadhyaya Swamini Brahmaprakasananda Saraswati
people.bio: Senior disciple of Swami Dayananda and chief ācārya of Arsha Vijnana Gurukulam, Nagpur.

people.name: Swamini Vedarthananda Saraswati
people.bio: Faculty member at AVG Anaikatti who also looks after its temples.

people.name: Swamini Saradananda Saraswati
people.bio: Faculty member at AVG Anaikatti who also looks after its temples.

people.name: Swamini Svatmavidyananda Saraswati
people.bio: Arsha Vidya teacher whose classes appear on the AVG Saylorsburg channel.

people.name: Swami Muktatmananda Saraswati
people.bio: Arsha Vidya teacher (Vedānta-sāra, Significance of OM series) at AVG Saylorsburg.

people.name: Swami Sachidananda (AVG)
people.bio: Arsha Vidya teacher and chanter at AVG Saylorsburg (Yoga of Objectivity series, satsangs).

people.name: Swami Advayatmananda
people.bio: Arsha Vidya teacher (Hastāmalakīyam course, guided meditations) at AVG Saylorsburg, 2025.

people.name: Swami Pratyagbodhananda
people.bio: Arsha Vidya teacher whose talks appear on the AVG channel.

people.name: Swamini Paraprajnananda
people.bio: Arsha Vidya teacher whose classes appear on the AVG channel.

people.name: Swami Atmaswarupananda
people.bio: Senior Divine Life Society monk who gives the morning meditation talks at the Christmas–New Year retreats, Sivananda Ashram.

people.name: Swami Krishnananda
people.bio: General secretary of the Divine Life Society for decades and prolific Vedānta lecturer (archival recordings).

people.name: Swami Kuvalayananda
people.bio: Founder of Kaivalyadhama (1924), pioneer of scientific yoga research.

people.name: Dr. Santosh Pandey
people.bio: Kaivalyadhama scholar teaching the Pātañjalayogasūtra, Śiva Saṃhitā chakra meditation and online workshops.

people.name: Dr. R. S. Bhogal
people.bio: Senior Kaivalyadhama teacher of kriyā, dhāraṇā and Vijñāna Bhairava meditation workshops.

people.name: Dr. O. P. Tiwari
people.bio: Long-time Kaivalyadhama secretary and prāṇāyāma teacher (talks on the institute channel).

people.name: KYM faculty (Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram)
people.bio: Collective teaching uploads of the Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram: chanting, Dhanur-dhyāna sādhanā, prāṇa lecture series.

people.name: Jagadguru Sri Bharati Tirtha Mahasannidhanam
people.bio: 36th Jagadguru Shankaracharya of the Sringeri Sharada Peetham.

people.name: Jagadguru Sri Vidhushekhara Bharati Sannidhanam
people.bio: Designated successor (37th) at Sringeri; gives Anugraha Bhashanam discourses and Dharma Vijaya Yatras.

people.name: Geshe Lhakdor (Lobsang Jordhen)
people.bio: Director of the Library of Tibetan Works and Archives, former English translator to the Dalai Lama; teaches introductory Buddhism and Atiśa at LTWA.

people.name: Ven. Tenzin Gache
people.bio: FPMT teacher presenting Nāgārjuna’s Seventy Stanzas and Sixty Stanzas at Root Institute.

people.name: Ven. Tenzin Legtsok
people.bio: FPMT teacher ("Exploring the Mind Itself") at Root Institute.

people.name: Geshe Tenzin Zopa
people.bio: Gelug geshe teaching Atiśa’s Lamp for the Path and the Wheel of Sharp Weapons at Root Institute.

people.name: Chökyi Nyima Rinpoche
people.bio: Abbot of Ka-Nying Shedrub Ling and founder of Rangjung Yeshe Institute, Kathmandu.
